text:
maria_cs: Quick heads-up — AstraPark renewal lands EOW. Procurement says they need a PO + net45, legal is pushing for a 9‑month term instead of 12, and finance asked for a line‑item invoice that includes the KMS add‑on. Current quote was $148,500 (12mo, seats same). I ran a quick prorate: 9mo would be $111,375. @eli_account_mgr can you confirm: 1) are we OK with net45 for this account under current ARR, 2) can we do the 9mo term at the prorated price without manager signoff, 3) confirm DocuSign vs e‑sign waiver path? Docsend with quote: https://docsend.com/s/astrapark-quote
eli_account_mgr: I can take this. Quick answers: 1) net45 is borderline — finance prefers net30 but we can make net45 if we get CFO approval note in the SOW. 2) 9mo prorate is fine within the standard renewal discount matrix (no extra approval). 3) DocuSign is required for enterprise SOWs here; waiver only for <$5k. I'll loop in finance/legal now.
jane_legal: FYI procurement asked for signature by their Director of IT, but contract needs an authorized signer (legal entity). If Director of IT is signing, we need a delegated signature doc or evidence of signing authority. Ask them for PO + signer title. Also: if they shorten to 9mo we should add a clause clarifying no automatic renewal on shorter term. :thinking_face:
ben_finance: @eli_account_mgr if we accept net45, we need a credit check flag and to record net45 in Chargebee metadata. Also they requested invoice line items split: Platform $120,000 + KMS $28,500 = $148,500 (12mo). For 9mo prorate: Platform $90,000 + KMS $21,375 = $111,375. I can generate a line‑item draft invoice once I get PO# and billing entity.
olivia_enablement: Heads-up — AstraPark requested onboarding training for 3 teams in week 1 post-sign. If dates shift because of signature timing, we should offer two shorter sessions rather than one big kickoff. I can hold 3 slots next week as tentative. Need seat list + Slack handles from them.
sam_support: Support will enable premium monitoring in staging — we need the staging subdomain and dev contact. Also capturing feedback: they asked for sample eval prompts; I'll prep a short eval pack to attach to the SOW as an appendix.
ops-bot: calendar: Created tentative event "AstraPark onboarding slot" for Mon/Tue/Wed next week, invites sent to olivia_enablement, maria_cs, eli_account_mgr.
maria_cs: Thanks — next steps from me: 1) ask customer for official PO# + signer name/title, 2) confirm if they'd prefer 9mo or stick to 12mo with a 3% budget increase, 3) send updated DocuSign once PO and signer confirmed. I'll ping procurement now.
eli_account_mgr: I'll add CFO approval note to the SOW template and set a reminder for finance to finish the credit check. If they push for earlier signature, we can accept a provisional PO and then finalize DocuSign within 7 days.
jane_legal: If they send delegated signature evidence, legal can sign off quickly. Otherwise expect a 24–48h legal review after DocuSign route is chosen.
ben_finance: @maria_cs share PO when you have it. I can push draft invoice same day. If their PO has different billing entity, expect tax/vat check which may add 1 business day.
maria_cs: procurement responded — they put PO incoming, signer listed as "Procurement Director (signed per delegation)" and will email delegation letter. They asked if we can produce DocuSign by Friday morning.
eli_account_mgr: Good — I'll prepare DocuSign tonight with 9mo prorate and 12mo option as alternate. We'll default to 9mo per their ask but include checkbox for 12mo. Tagging @olivia_enablement so training dates can be conditional.
olivia_enablement: Got it. I'll mark onboarding slots as tentative and prep two 2‑hour sessions. Also I'll build the short eval pack @sam_support mentioned and attach to DocuSign as appendix if possible.
sam_support: I'll prep the eval pack and staging checklist; pinging our infra contact for staging subdomain now.
maria_cs: Great. Final ask — capture customer feedback reason for shorter term in notes (they said budgeting cycle). I'll add that to thread so renewals team has context.
eli_account_mgr: I'll add "budget cycle, prefer 9mo" tag to the renewal record and set follow‑up 60 days before term end.
maria_cs: Thanks team — will update when PO and delegation email arrive. :thumbsup:
